Title: Released: Preview availability of Jupyter notebooks in Azure Machine Learning

Body.Content: You can author Jupyter notebooks directly from Azure Machine Learning. You have full access to Jupyter from any operating system and from any modern browser, directly from Azure Machine Learning Studio. In addition, you can publish any function, including those creating Machine Learning models, as a web service directly from the Jupyter notebook running on your machine. The result is a Machine Learning web service API that can be called to perform functions or predictions from client applications in real time and over the Internet. For more information, see the release announcement.
Body.Markdown:
You can author Jupyter notebooks directly from Azure Machine Learning. You have full access to Jupyter from any operating system and from any modern browser, directly from Azure Machine Learning Studio.

In addition, you can publish any function, including those creating Machine Learning models, as a web service directly from the Jupyter notebook running on your machine. The result is a Machine Learning web service API that can be called to perform functions or predictions from client applications in real time and over the Internet.

For more information, see the release announcement .
